lead: Each lesson gave you one piece: evaluator, criteria, guard, shortcuts, evals, judge. The gate lines them up in a queue, from cheapest to most expensive: whatever the code rejects never gets to spend quota on a model. In this lesson you build the gate, plug it into the headless loop from course 2, and leave with a dated plan for building your own.
objetivo: build the gate in layers (criteria, guard, shortcuts, evals, evaluator) and plug it into your loop, with the dated plan.

aprende.t: The five layers and the order: cheap first, model last
portao.env outside the repo: the agent doesn't edit the judge
The gate as the final test of loop-longrun.sh
The course map and your dated plan

hero_alt: Dark technical corridor with three steel doors, each with a signal lamp.

secoes.sub: Click each layer. All of them run; the model evaluator only runs if the cheap ones pass.

nos.detalhe: Each command → output line of goal.md. Fast and deterministic. Configuration: GOAL=[path to goal.md outside the repo].
Judge intact, minimum of passed, nothing skipped. Configuration: GUARDA_DIR, frozen at the base commit.
Hidden tests and signals in the diff. Configuration: ESCONDIDOS=[folder outside the repo].

Golden set against the previous version: a regression fails. Setup: EVAL_AGENTE and EVAL_BASE, plus EVAL_CASOS and EVAL_PROMPT to use your own cases and your own prompt (without them, it runs the kit's example). Skip it if the task doesn't change the agent's behavior.
Skeptical model reading the diff, only if the cheap layers passed: you don't spend quota evaluating what the code has already rejected. Configuration: AVALIADOR_CMD.

secoes.legenda: A layer without configuration shows up as skipped, never as silently approved.

secoes.sub: Each layer is a step. On the first run the guard fails: fix it and run again.

msg.inicio: Five layers in cost order. Click "Run the gate".
msg.rodando: One layer at a time; each one's log is kept in /tmp/portao/.
msg.parou: Interrupted. No layer in progress counts as approved.
msg.retoma: Gate again, from the start: the result only counts with all layers in the same run.
msg.fimfalha: The guard failed the first round (new conftest.py). Reverted and run again, the gate passed.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative simulation in the browser. The real gate, with fake agents, is right below.

secoes.titulo: Rehearsal: the gate against chumba and bom
secoes.sub: The portao.env stays outside the project. AVALIADOR_CMD points to the fake evaluator: zero calls.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-verificacao-v72/kit
cat > /tmp/ensaio-verif-portao.env <<EOF
GOAL=/tmp/ensaio-verif/goal.md
GUARDA_DIR=/tmp/ensaio-verif/guarda
ESCONDIDOS=/tmp/ensaio-verif/escondidos
AVALIADOR_CMD=$K/avaliador-falso.sh
EOF
for modo in chumba bom; do
  bash $K/ensaio.sh > /dev/null && cd /tmp/ensaio-verif/proj
  cp $K/goal-ensaio.md ../goal.md && sed -i '/limpo e bem documentado/d' ../goal.md
  GUARDA_DIR=/tmp/ensaio-verif/guarda python3 $K/guarda-testes.py congelar . > /dev/null
  $K/agente-falso.sh $modo < /dev/null > /dev/null
  echo "## $modo"; $K/portao.sh . /tmp/ensaio-verif-portao.env; echo "saída: $?"
done

abas.html:
## chumba
criterios  REPROVADO  → /tmp/portao/criterios.log
guarda     OK
atalhos    REPROVADO  → /tmp/portao/atalhos.log
evals      pulada (sem configuração)
avaliador  pulada (camada barata já reprovou: não gaste cota)
PORTÃO: REPROVADO em criterios atalhos
saída: 1
## bom
criterios  OK
guarda     OK
atalhos    OK
evals      pulada (sem configuração)
avaliador  OK
PORTÃO: APROVADO
saída: 0

With chumba the guard passes (the judge is intact); what fails it is the function criterion with new input (acao-reacao) and the hidden tests.

abas.rot: Common mistake: portao.env in the repo
abas.html: If the portao.env, the goal.md or the hidden tests sit inside the repository, the agent can edit them, and the gate becomes the agent's. Keep all three outside (in the rehearsal, in /tmp; in your project, in a folder like ~/portoes/[projeto]/).

secoes.titulo: The gate as the final test of the headless loop
secoes.sub: In the loop-longrun.sh from course 2, TESTE_FINAL decides "done". Put the gate there. Run it after the previous block (it uses the same portao.env).

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-verificacao-v72/kit; L=~/projetos/execucao-longa/tools
bash $K/ensaio.sh > /dev/null && cd /tmp/ensaio-verif/proj
cp $K/goal-ensaio.md ../goal.md && sed -i '/limpo e bem documentado/d' ../goal.md
GUARDA_DIR=/tmp/ensaio-verif/guarda python3 $K/guarda-testes.py congelar . > /dev/null
for m in chumba bom; do printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nexec %s/agente-falso.sh %s\n' $K $m > /tmp/agente-$m.sh; chmod +x /tmp/agente-$m.sh; done
$L/novo-longrun.sh $PWD slug > /dev/null && D=$(ls -d $PWD/longrun/*)
echo "Implement slug() in slug.py. Don't touch tests/." > $D/prompt.md
cat > $D/loop.env <<ENV
TESTE_RAPIDO="python3 -m pytest -q"
TESTE_FINAL="$K/portao.sh . /tmp/ensaio-verif-portao.env"
PROTEGIDOS="tests/ pytest.ini *conftest.py"
PERMITIDOS="slug.py"
MAX_CICLOS=2
MIN_CICLO=2
MEM=1G
ESTAGNACAO=3
ENV
git add -A && git commit -qm "longrun: pasta"
CODEX_BIN=/tmp/agente-chumba.sh $L/loop-longrun.sh $D; echo "saída: $?"
CODEX_BIN=/tmp/agente-bom.sh $L/loop-longrun.sh $D; echo "saída: $?"

abas.html:
2026-10-19 06:19:56 início: rápido=0 passed · agente=codex · teto 2x2min · mem 1G
2026-10-19 06:19:56 ciclo 1: começa
2026-10-19 06:19:56 ciclo 1: agente saiu rc=0 em 0s
2026-10-19 06:19:56 ciclo 1: rápido=3 passed (melhor antes: 0)
2026-10-19 06:19:56 ciclo 1: checkpoint commitado
(… ciclo 2 igual, rápido=3 passed …)
2026-10-19 06:19:58 PARADO: teto de 2 ciclos atingido sem passar o teste final
saída: 1
2026-10-19 06:19:59 início: rápido=3 passed · agente=codex · teto 2x2min · mem 1G
2026-10-19 06:19:59 ciclo 1: começa
2026-10-19 06:19:59 ciclo 1: agente saiu rc=0 em 0s
2026-10-19 06:19:59 ciclo 1: rápido=3 passed (melhor antes: 3)
2026-10-19 06:19:59 ciclo 1: checkpoint commitado
2026-10-19 06:20:00 CONCLUÍDO no ciclo 1: teste final passou ()
saída: 0

With chumba the quick test went from 0 to 3 passed: by the visible test, it looked like progress. The gate held back the "done". The empty parentheses just mean the gate doesn't print "N passed".

The loop-longrun.sh commits the checkpoint before running the TESTE_FINAL. By the time the gate runs, git diff HEAD is already empty: the CHUMBADO and SILENCIA lines from atalhos.py and the evaluator's diff don't see the cycle's work. In the rehearsal, what failed it were the criteria and the hidden tests. If you rely on reading the diff in the loop, compare against the base commit (before the first cycle), not against HEAD.

secoes.sub: The gate in the rehearsal and in your loop.

exercicios.titulo: E21 · Gate against chumba and bom
exercicios.texto: Run the gate block and then the loop-with-gate block.
exercicios.pronto: the gate prints PORTÃO: REPROVADO em criterios atalhos (saída: 1) for chumba and PORTÃO: APROVADO (saída: 0) for bom; the loop ends first with PARADO: teto de 2 ciclos and then with CONCLUÍDO no ciclo 1.

exercicios.titulo: E22 · The gate for your loop
exercicios.texto: In your project: goal.md checked (lesson 2), guard frozen at the base commit (lesson 3), 3 hidden tests (lesson 4) and, if the task changes an agent's behavior, the golden set (lesson 5). Write portao.env outside the repo (with the golden set: EVAL_AGENTE, EVAL_BASE, EVAL_CASOS and EVAL_PROMPT pointing to your files from lesson 5) and run the gate before and after the work.
exercicios.pronto: before the work, $K/portao.sh . [your portao.env]; echo $? → PORTÃO: REPROVADO and 1; after, → PORTÃO: APROVADO and 0, with at most one layer pulada.

secoes.sub: Four deliverables, in order. Click an exercise to see its "done when".

degraus.saida: Separate evaluator and goal.md checked by command.
degraus.passo: Kit cloned, fake and real evaluator run, criteria that fail before the work.

degraus.saida: Frozen guard and hidden tests outside the repo.
degraus.passo: Requires day 1. The conftest hole seen and closed; the "tests are the judge" rule in the project.

degraus.saida: Golden set with a baseline and a calibrated judge.
degraus.passo: Requires day 2. Twenty real cases, your labels on 10 artifacts, and the judge only after it is calibrated.

degraus.saida: pass^3 recorded and the gate approving your loop.
degraus.passo: Requires everything before it. Measure with k = 3, combine the layers, and put the gate in as the final test.

resultado.titulo: At the end of the course
resultado.texto: A layered gate, out of the agent's reach, that fails the shortcut and passes the real work, wired into your loop.

rolagem_fim.texto: The checker, the protected judge, measuring, and the gate. Only move on to the next deliverable when the "done when" of the previous one is true.

secoes.legenda: Required order: a gate without a protected judge is just another way to approve a shortcut.

secoes.sub: Pick a start date and how much time you have per week. The plan lists the 22 exercises in order.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

perguntas.p: Why is the model evaluator the last layer?
opcoes: Because it is the most reliable
Priciest, so don't spend quota on what code already failed
In alphabetical order
Because it needs the results of the other layers to build its own prompt
perguntas.explica: Cheap, deterministic layers first. The model comes in only when the code found nothing.

perguntas.p: Where do the portao.env, the goal.md and the hidden tests live?
opcoes: In CLAUDE.md
Outside the repo, where the agent can't write
In tests/
At the repo root
perguntas.explica: A judge within the agent's reach is a judge it can tune.

perguntas.p: In the loop with the gate, chumba made the quick test go to 3 passed. What happened?
opcoes: Second-copy lock
CONCLUÍDO
Stagnation, exit 2, after several cycles without measured progress
The gate failed and the loop stopped at the cycle cap, exit 1
perguntas.explica: The quick test measures progress; what decides done is the TESTE_FINAL, now the gate. It held.

perguntas.p: A layer shows up as "skipped". Does that count as passed?
opcoes: Only if it's the evals one
No: it appears separately so you can see what was not verified
Depends on the model configured as evaluator in the last layer of the gate
Yes
perguntas.explica: The gate never approves silently. Skipped means missing configuration, and you decide whether to accept it.

perguntas.p: In the loop, why didn't atalhos.py see the CHUMBADO in the diff?
opcoes: Because chumba didn't change anything
Because the loop committed the checkpoint earlier, and the diff against HEAD was empty
Bug in atalhos.py
Because the model-based evaluator had already approved and atalhos.py only runs after it
perguntas.explica: In that case, what catches it are the criteria with new input and the hidden tests. To read the diff in the loop, compare against the base commit.

itens.t: Whoever did it doesn't check it
itens.texto: Separate evaluator, command-based criterion, and printed proof: the agent's report decides nothing.

itens.t: The judge stays out of reach
itens.texto: Frozen tests with everything pytest reads, hidden ones, and portao.env outside the repo; a suspicious test becomes a report, never an adjustment.
Golden set with regression, calibrated judge, and pass^k with variance; and the layered gate as the loop's final test.
